inlines.v: OUTLAND'ISH, adjective 1. Foreign; not native. Nevertheless, even him did outlandish women cause to sin. Nehemiah 13:26. 2. Born or produced in the interior country, or among rude people; hence, vulgar; rustic; rude; clownish. [This is the sense in which the word is among us most generally used.]
